content:
maya (acct): NimbusTrust sent an RFP redux. They want a 10-business-day POC that must demonstrate: private deployment in their AWS account + optional air-gapped appliance for some offices, FIPS 140-2 HSM integration, FedRAMP posture questions, and a committed pricing schedule (12mo). Also asked for a one-page capability matrix and an exec-friendly summary.

ravi (solutions): Quick notes: hybrid (VPC + appliance) is doable but adds ops overhead. We'll need exact appliance footprint and network constraints. FedRAMP ask: we can provide controls mapping for our Private offering but not FedRAMP attestation unless they run in FedRAMP partner environment.

tess (eng): Latency target? They mentioned p95 <55ms for 24-32 token short replies. Achievable with dedicated A10s or our appliance with int8. Need their expected peak RPS and distribution of reply lengths. For appliance: we'll need physical rack specs and outbound management port.

ana (security): Key custody: Private + appliance -> customer-managed keys only. Draft line for RFI: "Customer retains exclusive control of cryptographic key material for Private and appliance deployments; Redwood stores encrypted key references and never has access to plaintext keys." Will attach control mappings for major FedRAMP families they asked about (AC, IA, SC).

maya (acct): POC commercial ask: they want a transient POC price and committed tiers. Can we offer a 7-10 day POC at a nominal tech-rate and examples for 4/12/48 GPU committed bands? Also need a short indemnity/contract note.

ravi (solutions): Proposed: POC = 50% off committed list for up to 10 days, limited to a max of 8 GPUs. Committed tiers: small=4, mid=12, large=48. I'll assemble a CSV with per-GPU month list, committed discount, and sample monthly totals.

tess (eng): I'll produce a concise capability matrix with rows: redwood-7B/13B/70B + appliance-70B, columns: quant (fp16/int8), p95 latency (24/32/64 tokens), reqs/sec per GPU/appliance, and $/token rough. Example row: "appliance-70B | int8 | 48ms p95 (32t) | 250 req/s appliance | $0.00075/token (committed)"

ana (security): Ask Nimbus for: HSM vendor+model+firmware, FedRAMP scope (which controls they need mapped), VPC CIDRs, allowed management ports for appliance, expected peak RPS, and sample compliance prompts (PII/redaction + highest-risk queries).

maya (acct): I'll request NDA and those infra items in the handoff. Also ask legal contact for indemnity language.

ticket-bot: Ticket #POC-8012 created and assigned to maya, ravi, tess, ana. Due 2024-12-02.

ravi (solutions): One more thing — call out quantization vs quality in the one-pager. We'll include a 2-row snapshot: latency-optimized (int8) vs fidelity-first (fp16) with a short note on hallucination checks.

tess (eng): I'll attach a tiny eval snippet for their prompts and include a note to run both configs during the POC.

maya (acct): Please drop the RFI appendix, capability matrix one-pager, and pricing CSV by EOD PT. I'll loop legal once we have the NDA. :thumbsup:
